We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list). Need to choose one that can be further processed with next template 1914389, then 1914390, then 149040, then 1914391.

We need to construct a JSON tree: root molecule is target SMILES. Children: reaction using template 29646, children are precursor molecules (maybe choose one). Then each precursor may have further reaction nodes.

We need to ensure each step uses the specified template in order.

We have applied 29646 and got three possible precursors:

Result from first apply_template: 
"(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C',))"

So three precursors:

1. "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"
2. "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO"
3. "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C"

We need to apply template 1914389 next. Which of these can be transformed? We attempted applying 1914389 to some variants and got results for some.

We applied 1914389 to the first (with Si protecting group) and got result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),)". So it gave two precursors: one is a molecule similar but with CC=O instead of the longer chain, and the other is "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". That seems like a split.

We also applied 1914389 to the third precursor (the simplest) and got no result.

We applied 1914389 to "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO" and got result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),)". So similar.

Thus we can choose precursor 2 (without Si) for next step.

So step1: target -> prec1 (choose "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO") using template 29646.

Step2: apply 1914389 to that precursor, yields two precursors: A = "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO" and B = "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". So reaction splits into two fragments.

Now step3: template 1914390 must be applied to each of those? The order says after 1914389, then 1914390. Likely apply 1914390 to each of the fragments that are suitable.

We applied 1914390 to A ("C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO") and got result: "(('CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1',),)". So A transforms to a larger molecule (maybe a protected version). That's one product.

We also applied 1914390 to B ("CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC") and got no result.

Thus we can proceed with A only.

Now step4: template 149040 must be applied to the product from step3: "CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1". We attempted and got no result. So maybe need to choose a different branch? Perhaps we should apply 149040 to a different precursor earlier.

Maybe the route expects using 149040 on a different molecule (maybe the B fragment). Let's test applying 149040 to B again? Already did, no result.

Maybe we need to apply 149040 to the product of 1914390 but maybe we need to deprotect first? The product contains an O[Si] group? Actually the product from 1914390 we got earlier with Si group: "CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1". That includes a silyl protecting group. We haven't deprotected yet. Perhaps 149040 works on deprotected version.

We can deprotect that molecule using deprotect_molecule tool. Let's try deprotect on that SMILES.
